name: Thoughtform Maze
introDiscord:
The maze changes when you think about it.

Unfortunately, knowing this also changes it.
introTwitch:
The maze changes when you think about it.

Unfortunately, knowing this also changes it.

thoughtform-maze-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Thoughtform Maze.

left.message:
You think about treasure.

A chest appears.

This seems suspiciously convenient.

right.message:
You wonder whether something is following you.

A Thoughtform Prowler appears.

STOP THINKING.

forward.message:
You imagine somewhere safe.

For once, the Nexus cooperates.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

thoughtform-maze-depths.prompt: Deeper within Thoughtform Maze, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
You briefly think:

'At least there isn't another Prowler.'

There is now another Prowler.

right.message:
You deliberately imagine Star Candies.

Success.

Useful brain.

forward.message:
One Berry sits beneath Shizuki's message:

'DO NOT THINK ABOUT GIANT BERRY.

Seriously.

It blocks hallway.'

thoughtform-maze-threshold.prompt: Near Unspoken Labyrinth, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message:
You focus on rest.

The maze forms a quiet room.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A fleeting worried thought becomes claws.

forward.message: A deliberately imagined coffer becomes real.

bossPromptDiscord:
Unspoken Labyrinth goes dark.

The one thing you don't want to imagine begins taking shape anyway.

Use /yes to face it or /no to go think about puppies or
something.
bossPromptTwitch:
Unspoken Labyrinth goes dark.

The one thing you don't want to imagine begins taking shape anyway.

Use !yes to face it or !no to go think about puppies or
something.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Unspoken Labyrinth. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
Fear becomes solid.

Fear-Made Huntress reveals itself!

completionText:
The maze stops responding.

Shizuki's final thought is carved into the wall:

'BERRIES.

BERRIES.

BERRIES.

Safety strategy.'
